title: Reflected / stored XSS
summary: Prove untrusted input executes in HTML/JS contexts in a victim browser.
steps: Inject a unique canary into search/reflect params from the map.
Confirm reflection context (HTML body, attribute, script) via response or browser.
Escalate to a minimal execution proof (alert/console) in-scope only.
If filtered, try one context-appropriate encoding — do not spray huge payload lists.
Stored: submit canary, reload as second identity if available.
On PASS: demonstrated script execution or unambiguous injectable context with repro URL.
kill_signals: Output encoded and CSP blocks with no viable bypass after context tests
references: PortSwigger: Find XSS / Reflected XSS / Stored XSS
